newsitem.title: USA: Family Dollar to open 300 stores, close 50.
newsitem.headline: Family Dollar to open 300 stores, close 50.

text.p: Family Dollar Stores Inc said Wednesday that it currently plans to open about new 300 stores and close about 50 stores in the fiscal year beginning September 1, 1997.
The company said this plan represents a substantial increase in store expansion above the pace of the current fiscal year, when it expects to open about 235 stores and close about 50 stores.
About 150 existing stores are currently expected to be expanded or relocated during the next fiscal year, the company said.
